review: Verified 2026-10-31 against public sources; owner sign-off pending (docs/SPEC_BPMN.md F-B25, D-B12). Neutral list, alphabetical within each category, never a recommendation. Each entry carries the public page it was checked against (source), its check date (asOf) and its verification status: verified (every fact listed was read on a public vendor page), partial (a field could not be confirmed and is left blank) or unverified (the vendor site could not be read); the note names renames, end-of-sale dates and the facts of the earlier draft that could not be confirmed and were removed. Integration "mcp": an MCP server published or documented by the vendor or project, or MCP client support in an AI coding tool. Facts are indicative as of the date; verify before use with a client.
